correctness.rationale: Tree transport norm equals the sum of pendant-edge absolute masses plus central-edge imbalance. Averaging arbitrary signed linear operators over cluster permutations/reflection reduces without loss to one alpha. The full signed alpha norm is a maximum of exact absolute-value expressions; monotonicity outside [1/2,1] and balancing the two affine constraints yield the displayed formula for all integers m≥2, real t>0, including threshold continuity. Free-space universal mapping property gives sharpness for arbitrary real Banach targets. Twelve independent unrestricted signed coefficient LP optimizations with 2^(2m+1) dual sign witnesses match the formula.

value.rationale: Exact complete classification of the universal two-point extension constant for a natural infinite tree family and every edge-separation parameter. The threshold at 2m/(m-2) for m>2 distinguishes saturated optimal local interpolation from a coupled regime, while m=2 exhibits persistent coupling. The phase boundary identifies when remote source values provably disappear from a globally optimal universal operator; the result is not a minor numerical gain or arbitrary finite instance.
